caption: The drawing shows a single, dark-colored, metallic silhouette of a horse in profile, facing left. The horse has a textured surface and stands with its left front leg extended forward and its left rear leg extended backward, as if in mid-stride. Both ears are pointed upright, and the mane is stylized with prominent, regularly spaced triangular points. The horse’s tail curves upwards and then downwards, and its mouth is slightly open. The figure is mounted on a flat, horizontal base. The background is plain and light-colored, with no additional objects or details. In the lower right corner, the signature “H. BADER” is visible.
